description: Start a timed math set for one exam (grade): problems spread over its math topics, with a time limit. Optional `count` (10, 25 or 50 problems, default 25) and `minutes` (15, 30, 60, 90 or 120, default 60). It covers the math portion only. Returns the set id, the deadline and every problem WITHOUT answers; submit_mock_exam scores all answers at once. Side effects: creates the learner's account on first use, a timed set record and a usage record. If a set is already open for that grade (even past its deadline) that set is returned instead and nothing new is created; after it is submitted, calling again starts a new one. Nothing is closed or cancelled by this call. A set left open more than 7 days past its deadline is closed without a score by a daily cleanup. Timed sets are not limited per month; at most 12 new timed sets can be started per hour per account (over it, nothing is created and the call can be retried later).

exam.description: Exam (grade) id, e.g. "ca-d2" or "ca-t1". Leave out to use the grade the user saved (save_study_settings); get_exam_overview lists the ids.

name: start_mock_exam
title: Start a timed mock exam
